summary: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance and sale of $1 billion aggregate liquidation preference of Series 16 Non-Step-Up Non-Cumulative Contingent Convertible Perpetual Preferred Tier 1 Securities. The securities are perpetual, contingent convertible, and non-cumulative, with conversion into ordinary shares under specified terms. The filing includes a pricing agreement dated April 30, 2026, with a syndicate of underwriters. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation event. The registrant is the issuer conducting a standard shelf takedown.
